value: The mouse1 block is used to take capital letters as input and output it’s corresponding musical rhythm, And it also stores which letter was pressed on keyboard into the heap which can be seen using show heap icon. And when we click on the play button  , Rhythms of all the letters which were typed until now are played. And when we click on the EMPTYHEAP ,All the letters till now are cleared from the heap and we can start again freshly.
